summary: Iran holds a massive funeral for former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei amid claims his compound was destroyed by Israeli strikes months earlier. Israel conducts repeated drone strikes in southern Lebanon, killing Hezbollah operatives and civilians, while IDF forces seize large weapons caches in Khadatha village. Trump threatens to destroy Iranian infrastructure if nuclear deal fails, as IRGC naval movements near Oman Strait are reported.
key_points: Funeral processions for former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei underway in Tehran with high security presence. (Source: @presstv/197241)
Israeli drone strike on Nabatieh al-Fawqa kills three, including a school principal and her family, near Hezbollah tunnel system. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374843)
IDF reports 150+ weapons seized, 90+ terror infrastructures destroyed, 20+ terrorists eliminated in Khadatha village, south Lebanon. (Source: @idf_telegram/24532)
Trump states US not seeking regime change in Iran but will 'finish the job' if no deal, threatening to destroy bridges, power plants in hours. (Source: @SharghDaily/170238)
Israeli settlers from 'Bashan Pioneers' attempt to cross into Syria, detained by IDF and handed to police. (Source: @manniefabian/58740)
Hamas supporter arrested in Jericho with M-16 rifle, communications gear, and banner glorifying 2024 attacker Ahmed Hamida. (Source: @New_security8200/202227)
IRGC speedboats reportedly close Oman corridor then forced to retreat, per social media video. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74803)
Foreign Minister Saar says Hamas seeks 'Hezbollah model' in Gaza; Israel insists on full Trump plan: disarmament and demilitarization. (Source: @N12chat/216113)

sections.executive_summary: Iran conducts a state funeral for former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei, whose Tehran compound was reportedly leveled by Israeli strikes on 9 Esfand 1404, raising questions about the condition of his remains. Israel intensifies operations in southern Lebanon with drone strikes on Nabatieh al-Fawqa killing Hezbollah members and civilians, while IDF ground forces consolidate control in Khadatha village, seizing over 150 weapons and destroying 90+ terror sites. Meanwhile, Trump escalates rhetoric, threatening rapid destruction of Iranian infrastructure if nuclear negotiations fail, as IRGC naval activity near the Strait of Hormuz adds maritime tension.

points: Massive funeral processions for former Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei are underway in Tehran, with state media showing mourners at Grand Mosalla and a police sniper positioned on a rooftop overlooking the ceremony. (Source: @presstv/197241, @presstv/197242, @lelotsenzura/93351)

Iranian media reports that on 9 Esfand 1404 (approx. Feb/March 2026), the first wave of Israeli attacks on Tehran severely bombed Khamenei's compound, leveling all buildings and making survival of his body 'very unlikely.' (Source: @VahidOnline/76792)

Trump, quoted by Iranian daily Shargh, says he is not seeking regime change but prefers a deal; otherwise 'we will finish the job,' boasting the US can destroy Iranian bridges, power plants, and energy factories 'in a small fraction of an afternoon.' (Source: @SharghDaily/170238, @SharghDaily/170228)
IRGC fast-attack craft reportedly attempted to close the Oman Sea corridor but were forced to withdraw, according to a video posted by a Telegram channel. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74803)
A Telegram channel claims the coffin carried in Khamenei's funeral is empty, alleging authorities misled the public about the procession route. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74800)

IDF 401st Brigade combat team, under 91st Division, has achieved operational control in Khadatha village in the southern Lebanon security zone over the past month, destroying 90+ Hezbollah terror infrastructures, eliminating 20+ terrorists, and seizing 150+ weapons including RPGs, anti-tank missiles, machine guns, and Kalashnikovs. (Source: @idf_telegram/24532)
Israeli Air Force struck a vehicle with four suspects approaching the security zone near Al-Aqida in southern Lebanon, removing an immediate threat to IDF forces. (Source: @New_security8200/202246)

Dozens of Israeli settlers from the 'Bashan Pioneers' group attempted to breach the border into Syria to establish settlements; they were detained by the IDF and transferred to police for questioning. (Source: @manniefabian/58740)

Foreign Minister Gideon Saar states Hamas's offer to make room for a technocrat government aims to avoid disarmament, seeking a 'Hezbollah model' in Gaza; Israel insists on full implementation of the Trump plan: disarming Hamas and all terror groups and demilitarizing Gaza. (Source: @N12chat/216113)

Central Command signed an order regulating the natural gas sector in Judea and Samaria (West Bank), establishing licensing, supervision, and legal framework for pipelines and facilities. (Source: @N12chat/216111)
Netanyahu, cited by an Iraqi channel, says weakening Iran opens the door to new peace agreements akin to the Abraham Accords. (Source: @naya_foriraq/81215)

Israeli police and IDF's Jordan Valley Lions Battalion arrested a 50-year-old Hamas supporter in Jericho after intelligence indicated he possessed weapons; seized an M-16 rifle, numerous communication devices, and a banner with Hamas flags glorifying Ahmed Hamida, who carried out a 2024 attack and was neutralized. (Source: @New_security8200/202227)

The Knesset Education Committee approved a gender-separation bill for academia, allowing segregation in classrooms, libraries, cafeterias, and labs, ahead of second and third readings. (Source: @yediotnews25/132310)

The Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee published the final version of a bill freezing arrests of yeshiva students until at least December, extending the initial three-month freeze; votes expected to begin shortly. (Source: @yediotnews25/132312, @amitsegal/62792)

Foreign Minister Saar reiterates Israel's demand for full disarmament of Hamas and demilitarization of Gaza under the Trump plan, rejecting a 'Hezbollah model' for the Strip. (Source: @N12chat/216113)

Multiple sources report an Israeli drone strike on Nabatieh al-Fawqa, near the Ali Taher ridge where Hezbollah maintains a major tunnel system; Lebanese media and a Telegram channel report three fatalities, including a school principal, her mother, a housekeeper, and a Syrian worker. (Source: @yediotnews25/132305, @manniefabian/58741, @rasedal3ado138e/374843, @rasedal3ado138e/374881)
A Telegram channel claims four Hezbollah members were killed in Nabatieh by the 'Israeli liberation army,' while the Islamic Republic remains silent. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74806)

IDF forces in Khadatha village have destroyed over 90 Hezbollah terror infrastructures, eliminated over 20 operatives, and confiscated over 150 weapons including RPGs, anti-tank missiles, machine guns, and Kalashnikovs during month-long operations. (Source: @idf_telegram/24532)
IDF struck a vehicle with suspects moving toward the security zone in the Al-Aqida area of southern Lebanon, neutralizing a threat to Israeli forces. (Source: @New_security8200/202246)
Additional Israeli strikes reported in southern Lebanon, per Lebanese media and Hebrew news channels. (Source: @yediotnews25/132316, @redlinkleb/30217)
Israeli settlers from the 'Bashan Pioneers' group attempted to cross the border into Syria to establish settlements; they were detained by the IDF and handed to police. (Source: @manniefabian/58740)
A Telegram channel reports artillery shelling on Al-Qusayr, Syria, with a map link for details. (Source: @redlinkleb/30252)

An Arabic-language post claims 'the fall of Baghdad' and 'the fall of Venezuela,' stating the narrative of the 'axis' is now sweeping over previous Israeli and American narratives. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374877)

Trump, quoted by Shargh Daily, calls the Strait of Hormuz a 'big money-making machine,' claims the US Navy imposed the largest naval blockade in history for two months, stopping all ship traffic, then lifted it as a deal neared. (Source: @SharghDaily/170238)
IRGC fast boats reportedly attempted to close the Oman Sea corridor but were forced to retreat, according to a video posted on a Telegram channel. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74803)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation on multiple fronts — Iran's leadership transition amid unresolved questions about Khamenei's fate, sustained Israeli kinetic operations in southern Lebanon with significant Hezbollah degradation, and Trump's explicit threats of rapid infrastructure destruction — creates a highly volatile environment. Israel's demonstrated ability to strike deep into Lebanon and seize territory suggests continued freedom of action, while Iran's muted response to Hezbollah losses and the Khamenei funeral opacity may indicate internal deliberation or restraint. The risk of miscalculation is elevated as US rhetoric hardens and IRGC naval probes test maritime boundaries.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese media and local reports document civilian casualties from Israeli drone strikes, fueling anger but without evident state-level retaliation from Beirut. Iranian state media projects unity at Khamenei's funeral, yet the absence of former presidents and claims of an empty coffin suggest elite fractures. Gulf states remain publicly silent, though Trump's Hormuz blockade claims and IRGC naval movements signal heightened maritime tension. Palestinian factions in the West Bank face intensified Israeli counterterrorism operations, while Hamas's political maneuvering in Gaza is dismissed by Israel as a ploy to retain arms.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Khadatha village operation reveals detailed Israeli intelligence on Hezbollah's southern Lebanon infrastructure, including tunnel systems near Ali Taher ridge. The Jericho arrest demonstrates effective Shin Bet-IDF coordination in Area A. Trump's specific threat timelines ('fraction of an afternoon') and target sets (bridges, power plants) suggest operational planning rather than mere rhetoric. The IRGC's aborted Oman corridor closure may indicate testing of US/coalition red lines. Khamenei's funeral optics — sniper overwatch, controlled routes, empty coffin claims — warrant monitoring for succession signals.
